senses.gloss: f. (= בָּסִיס; בסס) foot-stool, base, stand, step.—Pl. בְּסִיסָאוֹת Ar., בְּסִיסִיּוֹת, בְּסָסִיּוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 24:6">Kel. XXIV, 6</cite> <he>שלש בְּסָ׳ הן</he> (Ar. <he>בסי׳</he>) there are three stands, one before the bed (step) &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1">Num. R. s. 10</cite>, beg. <he>בסיסיות</he>, v. <cite ref="B00997"><he>בָּסִיס</he></cite>.
